verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only general building blocks. These are a one-API messaging send (twilio-docs-19) and programmable responses to incoming calls (twilio-docs-23), from which a developer could construct auto-replies or missed-call text-back. Nothing documents an auto-reply, after-hours reply, missed-call text-back, or scheduled-send capability. The hobbyist's SMS calendar alarms are a user-side workaround, not a product scheduling feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can send auto-replies and scheduled texts, like missed-call text-back and after-hours replies
